01Multi agent systems

Trinetra

An autonomous incident response system. It watches a live web application across alerts, logs, metrics and traces, reasons over the whole incident, and selects an approved remediation runbook.

Commander, telemetry, triage and documentation agents sit in tiers behind a dry run first executor, with a structured audit trail and MCP tool integration.

Result /gated, verifiable automated recovery
02Computer vision

GymCom

A live workout form coach. Pose tracking runs in the browser, a FastAPI backend handles analysis, and Claude writes the coaching report, in both real time and uploaded video modes.

Exercise specific joint angle thresholds drive rep counting, form scoring and symmetry feedback. Frame sampling keeps payloads light enough to deploy on Vercel and Render.

Result /real time inference, no GPU
03Deep learning

ResNet ViT
deepfake
detection

A hybrid residual network and vision transformer that reads local forgery artefacts and global facial semantics in one pass, so the classifier holds up on compressed, in the wild footage.

Result /86% on Celeb DFv2
04Generative modeling

Synthetic
MRI

A 2D denoising diffusion model in MONAI generating axial FLAIR slices from BraTS PED, built to fill the gap where rare pediatric tumor data simply does not exist.

The synthetic slices went back into a ResNet18 classification pipeline as training data.

Result /accuracy 82% to 88%
